iti9:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti9:2.1: Lobhaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya. Lobhañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetam iti vuccati:
iti9:3.1: Yena lobhena luddhāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ lobhaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti9:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||9||
